title: Workspaces, projects and people (+ project kickoff)
description: Use when creating or kicking off (kickoff, novo projeto) an LPM project or workspace, changing its settings, roles, routing profile, archive or delete, or managing members and teams. Not for cycles, milestones or labels alone (use lpm-plan-work) or credentials (use lpm-access).
doneWhen: The change is visible on re-read; a delete came only after a completed export or the owner's quoted skip; a kickoff passes every flow-kickoff.md exit criterion.
authorityCeiling: Creates and settings [C], team create [A]; roles, routing and moves need an owner instruction; delete_project [O].
